name: AvashoG2P-Benchmark
description: A grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) benchmark for evaluating models that convert written text into phonetic transcriptions. It measures accuracy of predicted phoneme sequences against reference pronunciations across languages/lexicons in the dataset.
evaluation_method: word-level exact match (word accuracy) and phoneme error rate (PER)
reputation: A focused G2P benchmark on Hugging Face with modest adoption among speech and NLP researchers.
